notes: DeepFlux 8.2 - player keys fixed, blue rain. Arrow-key seeking (plus Space, F and the other player shortcuts) now works in the full player even when the video never takes keyboard focus - previously, with SVP's out-of-process playback, clicking the video focused nothing and every player key died; focus is now seated on playback and stranded keys are forwarded from the tab. The Agent tab's idle screen gets a blue Matrix-style digital rain behind the banner (runs only before the first message, stops when hidden).
